title: skills(objectstack-data): object colour guidance says 'avoid repeats in one app'; the platform now colours by business family
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · the follow-up named by #36592 ("teach AI authors to pick a colour", the maintainer's direct dispatch 「立卡派」), filed by seat repo:objectstack#1 after PR #36605 merged.

## What
PR #36605 gave the built-in and example objects a palette `color`, picked by **business family**. The maintainer approved the family table as written (2026-11-23, 03:54Z). Its rules:
- one hue per family (people `blue`, security `purple`, approvals and work `orange`, messaging `pink`, integrations `teal`, reference data and finance `green`, audit and settings `amber`);
- `red` left unused because it reads as an alarm;
- objects nobody opens in the console keep no `color` and stay `gray`.

`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` (the `color` row of the object property table) tells AI authors instead: "Give every object one; avoid repeats in one app". That conflicts with the platform's own practice. With nine names, any app over nine objects must repeat a colour. The skill also gives no reason to pick one hue over another. `references/examples-objects.md`'s object example has an `icon` but no `color`.

## Done when
- The `color` guidance in `skills/objectstack-data` tells an author to group the app's objects into a few business families, give each family one palette name, reserve `red` for objects that really are alerts, and leave internal or never-opened objects without a colour. It cites the platform's own objects as the worked example. It does not name card ids.
- The object example in `references/examples-objects.md` declares a `color`.
- If an eval in `skills/objectstack-data/evals/` checks object authoring, its reference answer agrees with the new guidance.

reach: every AI-authored object; the console draws the colour on nav, headers, related lists and search.
Business reason: AI-built apps should look as organised as the platform's own Setup.
Reader: `skills/**` (Tier H; os-zhuang approves).
Dedupe: `object color skill`, `avoid repeats in one app`, `palette family` → none.
Grade suggestion: p2. Triage decides.
